capability: A post-commit CLI --report never overwrites a committed file listed in the receipt: the primary output, every delivered bundle artifact and any committed additional delivery
searchEvidence: PR #457 automatic review (P1) at src/NvtFwCombiner.Cli/CliCompositionRunSupport.cs:137: the post-commit report guard protects only CommittedOutputId, so a bundle Build whose --report names another delivered artifact (a Standard Merge <bundle>/dp.bin source copy or an AB additional-delivery file) overwrites it after CliBundleOptions.PrintReceiptAsync printed its SHA-256, and the CLI still exits 0.

The pre-run guards cannot see those files: EnsureReportDoesNotAliasProtectedPaths compares the original input paths and skips output protection for bundles, and ProtectedCompositionDestinationProvider applies the Application's CLI report protected path to loose writers only, not to AtomicBundleCompositionOutputWriter.

The actual committed set is carried by the run result: CommittedOutputId, Report.BundleDelivery (ResolvedDirectory with every Artifacts[].DeliveredFileName, the list CliBundleOptions.PrintReceiptAsync prints) and DeliveryArtifacts[].OutputPath for each committed additional delivery, loose or bundled (CompositionRunService).

rg -n 'ResolvedDirectory|DeliveryArtifacts' src: no existing owner enumerates committed artifact paths from a run result, so the single post-commit guard admitted by CLI-REPORT-RECEIPT-1113-01 is extended rather than adding a second check.

Coverage limit: the CLI cannot produce a loose additional delivery (--include-a-flashcode requires --bundle-parent, BundleCliCommandTests.AbAdditionalDeliveryRequiresAtomicBundle, and no CLI handler sets AdditionalDeliveryOutputPath), so the loose DeliveryArtifacts[].OutputPath branch is covered by code only; the CLI regressions cover a bundle source copy (<bundle>/dp.bin) and a bundled additional delivery.
semanticOwner: CliCompositionRunSupport's result-aware WriteReportJsonAsync remains the only post-commit CLI report guard; it derives its protected set from the actual commit result and keeps using ProtectedPathGuard.EnsureDoesNotAlias. The Application result, the bundle writer, the receipt printers and the handlers are unchanged.
terminalContract: After a Build commits, the requested --report is refused when it resolves to any committed file of the run: the primary output (CommittedOutputId), every artifact of the promoted bundle (ResolvedDirectory with each delivered file name, as listed in the receipt) and every committed additional delivery, loose or bundled. A refused report is not written; the CLI keeps the printed receipt, prints one cli.report.failed partial-success issue on stderr, writes no Report line and exits 0, so every committed file keeps the bytes and SHA-256 its receipt printed. Reports naming other paths, uncommitted runs, output bytes, names and ranges are unchanged.

designReview.evidence: Bounded local R1 correction of the existing post-commit CLI report guard, found by the PR #457 automatic review, with no Application, profile, firmware byte, range or contract change.

finalReview.evidence: Independent final review by codex/gpt-6-sol: APPROVED. Independent read-only review of exact head a0b1681aeb26596ff784e2bacadb5ebaa6e75d11 against ef751a14f5f005b72bf7826cf7a827de3bb73b3a found no P0-P3 issues. The existing post-commit report guard now protects the primary output, every artifact in the actual promoted bundle receipt, and every committed additional delivery path, including the loose path. The bundle writer commits no unlisted sidecar. Regressions compare delivered bytes with the receipt hashes for a source copy and bundled additional delivery; the loose additional delivery path is covered by code only because the CLI cannot produce it. The terminal contract and mutable paths match the diff; no firmware byte, range, CRC, naming, or profile behavior changed. Implementer tests: Bootstrap 1908/1908, Architecture 269/269, and 2 of 22 receipt tests fail on the previous guard (reported, not rerun by the read-only reviewer). Resolves the automated P1 review thread on pull request #457.
